Do not mix v03 rounded garments with v04 block garments without fitting and revalidation
clothing_geometry: Independent modular shells with intentional articulated hip/knee interfaces; not a cloth simulation
compatibility_status: Native Blender and fresh GLB imports verified; engine controller integration not performed
